description: Get one sync of a Foundry connector, with its status, rows and error. With wait, waits up to 25 s while it runs; call again until it ends.

sync_id.description: The sync's id, as helix_foundry_list_connectors (last_sync) or a sync_connector action returned it.

wait.description: Wait up to 25 s while it is queued or running, then return it either way; call again until it ends.

workspace_id.description: Helix workspace identifier. May be empty when the caller has only one workspace (a service key always does).

name: helix_foundry_get_sync
title: Get a connector sync
